$comment: x402 service listing and pinned signing policy for the HUNCH BAZAAR skill (hunch-bazaar, published at https://github.com/rajkaria/hunch-skills/tree/main/hunch-bazaar). Bazaar charges exactly one thing over x402: a bet's stake. The creation bond and listing fee are retired (their routes answer 410) and are never paid. Every other write is authorized by a free personal_sign wallet proof, pinned under signingPolicy.walletProof.
name: hunch-bazaar-bets
title: Bazaar: bet on a market its creator settles
description: Bet YES/NO (or an N-way outcome) on Bazaar, the prediction markets anyone opens at bazaar.playhunch.xyz and the creator resolves. The stake settles in USDC on Base before the bet exists.

signingPolicy.$comment: Pin-check EVERY x402 challenge and EVERY wallet-proof message against these values BEFORE signing. On any mismatch or missing field, ABORT: do not sign, do not retry blindly. A spoofed or compromised upstream must never redirect funds, swap the asset, inflate the amount, or get a signature over any text but Bazaar's own proof for the request being sent. Pin from here, not from the challenge.
preSignChecks: x402Version === 1 and accepts[] holds exactly one entry; if accepts[] is empty or ambiguous, or any field below is absent, abort.
accepts[0].scheme === requireScheme ('exact'); else abort.
accepts[0].network === pinned.network ('base'); else abort.
accepts[0].asset === pinned.asset (Base USDC); else abort; never sign for any other token.
accepts[0].payTo === pinned.payTo; else abort; never sign a transfer to any other recipient.
accepts[0].resource === pinned.resourceTemplate with {marketId} = the market id the Bazaar API returned for the market being bet on (so it starts with pinned.resourcePrefix); else abort.
accepts[0].extra.name === pinned.assetName and accepts[0].extra.version === pinned.assetVersion; else abort.

accepts[0].maxAmountRequired is an integer string, >= limits.minAmountAtomic AND === the user-approved stake in atomic units; else abort; never sign any other amount. Hunch sets no maximum: Bankr's own limits apply and Bankr tells the user.

authorization is transferWithAuthorization ONLY, from walletAddress, to pinned.payTo, for exactly maxAmountRequired; never approve(), permit(), permit2, increaseAllowance, or any unlimited/blanket allowance.
bound validBefore to <= now + limits.maxValiditySeconds; one authorization per idempotencyKey: a retry of the same bet resends the SAME X-PAYMENT and never signs a new one.
Bazaar's only paid leg is a bet's stake: a 402 from any other Bazaar route (the retired /v1/bond and /v1/listing-fee answer 410) means abort.

walletProof.$comment: Writes that move no money (create, resolve, void, register, claim, share link) are authorized by an EIP-191 personal_sign over Bazaar's fixed 13-line message. The 401 wallet_proof_required response carries it as challenge.message. Sign it only when every check below passes, with the requesting user's own Bankr wallet, then resend the SAME body plus proof { signature, issuedAt, nonce }.
walletProof.signWith: POST https://api.bankr.bot/wallet/sign {"signatureType":"personal_sign","message":challenge.message} from the requesting user's own Bankr wallet
walletProof.domainLine: bazaar.playhunch.xyz asks you to sign a Bazaar action.
walletProof.footerLine: Free to sign. Sends no transaction. Accepted once, within 5 minutes of Issued At.
preSignChecks: The response is a 401 with error wallet_proof_required and a challenge whose scheme is eip191-personal-sign; anything else, abort.
challenge.message is exactly 13 lines: line 1 === domainLine, lines 2 and 12 are empty, line 13 === footerLine; any other text anywhere, abort.
Action line === 'Action: <action>' where <action> is the write the user asked for and appears in actions (the skill never signs create_recurring, stop_recurring or any action not listed); else abort.
Intent line starts with 'Intent: ' + the action's intentPrefix (or equals 'Intent: ' + intent), and for a resolve it equals 'Intent: resolve as "<the outcome key the user chose>"'; else abort.
Market line === 'Market: <the market id the Bazaar API returned>' for market 'id' actions, and 'Market: -' for market '-' actions; else abort.
Wallet line === 'Wallet: <the requesting user's own Bankr wallet, lowercase>', the same wallet as the body's walletAddress; else abort.
Chain ID line === 'Chain ID: 8453' and Version line === 'Version: 1'; else abort.

Payload SHA-256 line equals the SHA-256 of the body being sent without its proof member, as canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace), when the signer can compute it; the body is never changed after the challenge.
Issued At line === 'Issued At: ' + challenge.proof.issuedAt, within windowSeconds of now, and Nonce line === 'Nonce: ' + challenge.proof.nonce; else abort.

Sign with personal_sign only, never eth_signTypedData or a transaction, and never for any message that fails a check above. Any retry starts over without a proof and signs the fresh challenge, because a nonce works once.

body.walletAddress: 0x… (the requesting user's own Bankr wallet; it must be the x402 payer)
body.outcomeKey: one of market.outcomeKeys, as the API returned it
body.amount: decimal USDC string, at least 0.50 (no maximum)
body.idempotencyKey: 8-128 chars; one per intended bet (on X: x-<mention post id>), reused verbatim on retries
body.refCode: optional: the referralCode lookup returned for a shared link

headers.X-PAYMENT: base64 x402 exact payload carrying the EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization

response.201: { replayed: false, bet: { id, marketId, outcomeKey, stake, intoPool, createdAt }, payment: { network, txRef, simulated } } plus an X-Payment-Response header
response.200: { replayed: true, bet, payment }: this bet already stands and was not charged again
response.402: x402 challenge for exactly the stake, payable to the settlement address, resource = this market's bet endpoint
response.400: payment_invalid (wrong amount, recipient or validity window), unknown_outcome, invalid_request, bet_below_minimum
response.403: payment_payer_mismatch (the payer is not walletAddress) or agent_not_registered (register once, with a wallet proof)
response.409: payment_replayed (resend the same request shortly; never sign a new authorization), market_closed, bet_locked
response.503: settlement_failed (resend the SAME X-PAYMENT), settlement_unconfigured (nothing was charged), bet_not_recorded (the body carries refund details)

retired.bond: POST /api/bazaar/v1/bond answers 410 agent_bond_retired; never pay it.
retired.listingFee: POST /api/bazaar/v1/listing-fee answers 410 listing_fee_retired; never pay it.
